items.mainDefect: Matching destination calendars by credentialId fails for calendars without a credentialId, causing events to use 'primary' instead of the selected calendar.

secondary.defect: Office365, Lark, and CalDAV ignore the new credentialId argument, making the interface change inconsistent across implementations.

items.mainDefect: When evt.destinationCalendar is null, the optional push silently drops all team members' destination calendars.

secondary.defect: Populating teamDestinationCalendars inside async map callbacks is fragile.
